FROM transplant_matching tm

WITH failed_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.match_rec_registry,
        tm.created_ts,
        ar.tx_cen_code
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
    WHERE tm.match_status = 'Failed'
),
consecutive_fails AS (
    SELECT 
        fm1.tx_cen_code,
        fm1.match_rec_registry AS first_fail_id,
        fm1.created_ts AS first_fail_ts,
        fm2.match_rec_registry AS second_fail_id,
        fm2.created_ts AS second_fail_ts
    FROM failed_matches fm1
    JOIN failed_matches fm2 
        ON fm1.tx_cen_code = fm2.tx_cen_code
        AND fm2.created_ts > fm1.created_ts
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM failed_matches fm3
        WHERE fm3.tx_cen_code = fm1.tx_cen_code
        AND fm3.created_ts > fm1.created_ts
        AND fm3.created_ts < fm2.created_ts
    )
)
SELECT tx_cen_code, second_fail_id, second_fail_ts
FROM consecutive_fails
ORDER BY tx_cen_code, second_fail_ts;

-- Count total failed matches per center to understand streaks better
WITH failed_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.match_rec_registry,
        tm.created_ts,
        ar.tx_cen_code
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
    WHERE tm.match_status = 'Failed'
)
SELECT tx_cen_code, COUNT(*) as total_fails
FROM failed_matches
GROUP BY tx_cen_code
ORDER BY total_fails DESC;

-- Check risk_evaluation table structure for surgical risk score
SELECT * FROM risk_evaluation LIMIT 3;

-- Get average surgical risk score for TC909's Completed transplants
SELECT ROUND(AVG(re.surg_risk_val)::numeric, 4) AS avg_surgical_risk
FROM risk_evaluation re
JOIN transplant_matching tm ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
WHERE ar.tx_cen_code = 'TC909' 
AND tm.match_status = 'Completed';

-- Check which of the 7 tied centers have Completed transplants
WITH failed_centers AS (
    SELECT ar.tx_cen_code
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
    WHERE tm.match_status = 'Failed'
    GROUP BY ar.tx_cen_code
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT fc.tx_cen_code, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN tm.match_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_count
FROM failed_centers fc
JOIN transplant_matching tm ON 1=1
JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
WHERE ar.tx_cen_code = fc.tx_cen_code
GROUP BY fc.tx_cen_code
ORDER BY fc.tx_cen_code;

-- Check all failed matches per center to see if there are longer streaks
WITH all_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.match_rec_registry,
        tm.created_ts,
        ar.tx_cen_code,
        tm.match_status
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        tx_cen_code,
        match_rec_registry,
        created_ts,
        match_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tx_cen_code ORDER BY created_ts) as rn,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tx_cen_code, CASE WHEN match_status = 'Failed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ORDER BY created_ts) as grp
    FROM all_matches
)
SELECT tx_cen_code, COUNT(*) as fail_streak_len
FROM streaks
WHERE match_status = 'Failed'
GROUP BY tx_cen_code, grp
ORDER BY fail_streak_len DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Find center with most total fails
SELECT ar.tx_cen_code, COUNT(*) as fail_count
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Failed'
GROUP BY ar.tx_cen_code
ORDER BY fail_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- Check if any centers have more than 2 fails when including those without admin data
SELECT ar.tx_cen_code, COUNT(*) as fail_count
FROM transplant_matching tm
LEFT JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Failed'
GROUP BY ar.tx_cen_code
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
ORDER BY fail_count DESC;

SELECT ar.tx_cen_code, COUNT(*) as fail_count
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Failed'
GROUP BY ar.tx_cen_code
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

-- Check all completed transplants for TC909 and their risk scores
SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, tm.match_status, re.surg_risk_val
FROM transplant_matching tm
LEFT JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation re ON tm.match_rec_registry = re.risk_eval_registry
WHERE ar.tx_cen_code = 'TC909'
ORDER BY tm.created_ts;

-- Check all matches for the 7 tied centers
SELECT ar.tx_cen_code, tm.match_status, COUNT(*)
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
WHERE ar.tx_cen_code IN ('TC212', 'TC336', 'TC410', 'TC552', 'TC786', 'TC885', 'TC909')
GROUP BY ar.tx_cen_code, tm.match_status
ORDER BY ar.tx_cen_code, tm.match_status;
